ModuleDescription: PICO eye and face tracking for VRCFaceTracking, receiving data from PicoFacialBridge, PICO Connect, Streaming Assistant, or PicoFacialDataDaemon. Supports native gaze, mode-based eyelid tracking, and configurable expression processing.
UsageInstructions: Disable older PICO tracking modules, install this module, and restart VRCFaceTracking 5.4.5. Configure UnifiedPicoModule.json and restart VRCFT to apply changes. Defaults prefer native gaze, use EyeBlink for eyelids in normal mode, and prefer native Openness with Blink fallback in enhanced mode. EyeWide is amplified 2x; other expression corrections are off. See the README for configuration and compatibility details.
